skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature, characteristics, functions, roles, and properties of social insurance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand and master the concepts, nature, characteristics, functions, roles, and properties of social insurance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing the importance of social insurance within the social security system
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze the significance of social insurance within the social security system and its relationship with economic growth.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Mastering the system of social insurance benefits and financial aspects of social insurance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand and master the system of social insurance benefits and the financial aspects of social insurance, distinguishing between social insurance finance and national budget and corporate finance.
Students will develop the ability to work independently and in teams, critical thinking, and the ability to inspire others.
Students will develop adaptability and the ability to learn independently, logical and critical thinking skills, and planning abilities.
